name: Global Knowledge Base & Relationship Graph
purpose: Axiomatic domain knowledge graph, inverted index ranking, license provenance auditing, and zero-fabrication partition management.
registration: DomainPartitionRegistry::register_partition; FoundationalKnowledgeGraph::populate_foundational_axiomatic_graph; KnowledgeDuplicateEngine::register_entry records content hash for deduplication.
discovery: GlobalKnowledgeBase::query_knowledge performs inverted index query; FoundationalKnowledgeGraph::get_relationship_chain walks graph.
execution: KnowledgePipeline ingests, verifies license, validates schema, deduplicates, computes dynamic content SHA, and indexes entries.
memory_link: Retrieved knowledge concepts link directly to episodic query tags.
learning_link: TopicResearcher autonomously fetches, verifies, and proposes new knowledge candidates.
self_evolution_link: Dynamic graph expansion: newly discovered axioms connect to existing foundational nodes.
world_model_link: Knowledge ≠ World Model. Knowledge graph provides factual axioms; WorldStateTracker provides dynamic entity states. Knowledge feeds WorldStateTracker for entity inference but they are separate subsystems.
curriculum_link: Directly maps to cognitive knowledge ontology and educational curriculum concepts.
safety_gates: LicenseProvenanceEngine strictly enforces SPDX permissive/educational licenses
KnowledgeValidationEngine rejects entries that fail schema or content validation
KnowledgeDuplicateEngine uses dynamic runtime SHA registry to prevent duplicate ingestion — no static hash tables
Zero fabrication: only verified real source literature admitted

lifecycle.1_ingest: Raw document ingested from verified download pool or curriculum compiler
lifecycle.2_audit: LicenseProvenanceEngine verifies permissive SPDX license and origin proof
lifecycle.3_validate: KnowledgeValidationEngine validates schema, content quality, and provenance fields
lifecycle.4_dedup: KnowledgeDuplicateEngine checks dynamic runtime SHA registry — rejects if duplicate
lifecycle.5_hash: Dynamic SHA-256 computed from content bytes (no hardcodes, no static tables)
lifecycle.6_index: ScalableKnowledgeIndex inserts BM25 inverted index tokens
lifecycle.7_link: FoundationalKnowledgeGraph connects concept to parent, child, and axiomatic relations
lifecycle.8_serve: Real-time query retrieval enriches cognitive prompt context
lifecycle.9_audit_sync: Graph and inverted index synced transactionally to storage
